queue_operations_verification.atomicity: 7 Lua scripts (JOIN/TOUCH/CANCEL/CLAIM/RELEASE/EXPIRE/SIZE) with fully declared KEYS; transitions execute via atomic EVAL with 2s deadline and no timers left behind

cross_device_deduplication.same_op_key: Returns deepEqual identical cached response across devices/service instances
cross_device_deduplication.idempotent_rejoin: Same mode with new opKey preserves original joinedAt score, recomputes wait time, and leaves exactly one index member
cross_device_deduplication.conflicting_mode: Throws ALREADY_QUEUED when attempting to join other mode while queued

eligibility_enforcement.durable_checks: Direct PostgreSQL re-read of identity.eligibility and core.actor_occupancy
eligibility_enforcement.rejections: Unverified, suspended, security-hold, and occupied actors are refused with INELIGIBLE; no index member created; occupied actor reports matched

cancellation_races.before_match: Cancels cleanly, removes candidate from index, sets status to idle, idempotent on opKey
cancellation_races.offered_match: Reports matched with termsHash/expires; cancel declines offer in Core via {type: 'decline'} and sets status to cancelled
cancellation_races.playing_match: Cancel returns {state: 'playing', matchId} and leaves match in PLAYING status without disturbance

heartbeat_and_lease_recovery.active_heartbeat: Refreshes 45s lease and ticket TTL, keeps searching state, preserves original joinedAt
heartbeat_and_lease_recovery.abandoned_lease: Client stopping heartbeats loses lease; expireAbandoned returns count and purges index member
heartbeat_and_lease_recovery.no_phantom_entries: Dead client leaves 0 match participants and 0 occupancy rows in PostgreSQL
heartbeat_and_lease_recovery.disconnected_state: Lapsed client reads {state: 'disconnected'} and its stale member is purged

claim_and_release.atomic_claim: Concurrent claimCandidates calls produce disjoint candidate sets with distinct non-empty claim IDs
claim_and_release.requeue_preservation: releaseClaim with requeue: true re-queues candidate at original FIFO joinedAt score; requeue: false removes permanently

bounded_candidate_indices.global_cap: maxTickets cap enforced across ranked and casual modes; excess attempts reject with QUEUE_FULL without indexing
bounded_candidate_indices.capacity_reclamation: Expired candidates reclaimed by expireAbandoned restore available slots; auditUnboundedKeys returns empty array
